summary: Ran tests/03-for-index-html-page-in-idee/picker.js (about 95 checks, plain Node + the playwright package from tests/node_modules, system Chrome) against the chapter picker in the Quick idea box. Pre-fill, title-only diacritic/case-insensitive search, ordering, the 50-row render cap, click and keyboard picking, x-clear, routing precedence A-D including verbatim Name: under a pick or a unique search, the ignored-words hints, the append format, open-chapter editor/wbDirty sync, deleted-pick fallback, XSS-safe rendering, Ctrl+S/Ctrl+I/Escape/Ctrl+Enter inside the picker, and en/ro strings all behave per the spec. One real defect was found: pressing Ctrl+Enter twice in quick succession saves the idea twice, because saveIdea() has no re-entrancy guard. The suite fails on that check only. I did not run tests/idea.js or tests/verify.js. Decisions: the suite uses the plain-node style of the existing tests/ scripts (no @playwright/test or new package.json), because the repo forbids new tooling at the root and playwright is already installed in tests/. The UI language is forced to en at the start of the run because the app defaults to ro. Note: Bash became unavailable partway through the session, so my final edits to the test file and the commit may have been blocked; see the last run result in this summary: the last successful run showed exactly one failing check (double Ctrl+Enter).

bugs.description: saveIdea() (js/markdown/idea.js) is not guarded against a second invocation while the first is still awaiting its persistence writes. The textarea is only cleared and the modal closed after ideaAppendTo() resolves, so a second Ctrl+Enter (or a double-click on Save) issued in that window appends the same idea a second time to the target chapter.
bugs.repro_steps: 1. Open index.html with a chapter open (e.g. Fizică). 2. Press Ctrl+Alt+I. 3. Type 'dup' in the idea textarea. 4. Press Ctrl+Enter twice in immediate succession (in the test: two keyboard.press('Control+Enter') calls back to back). 5. Read the chapter content.
bugs.actual: The idea 'dup' appears twice in the chapter (test counted 2 occurrences). Predates the picker but is reachable from the new #idea-chapter Ctrl+Enter handler as well.
